title: Life insurers rally up to 5% on premium data

timeline.title: Life insurers rally up to 5% on premium data
timeline.line: October new business premium grew 26.2% year on year, helped by LIC and private players
more: ICICI Life +4.25%, HDFC Life +4.08%, Max Financial +4.06%, SBI Life +3.05%
HSBC says industry individual APE growth moderated to about 5% in October
One brokerage expects the trend to hold until distribution rules are finalised

src.title: ICICI Life, HDFC Life, SBI Life, Max Financial shares climb; here's what HSBC says - BusinessToday
